title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels

source.rightsBoundary: The exact current B2SHARE v2 page is openly downloadable but its displayed License field is blank. EUDAT B2FIND metadata for the ProBayes dataset family records CC-BY/openAccess, but MouldMaster does not infer a licence version or redistribute this v2 Parquet. Dataset acceptance relies on documented lawful open access plus exact-file profiling, not on a redistribution claim.

publishedVsObservedStructure.discrepancyHandling: The source page's 334-feature description is retained as publisher metadata, but the exact v2 Parquet contains 364 top-level Arrow fields. MouldMaster preserves the physical schema and does not drop 30 fields to force a match.

experimentalContext.rowSemantics: one injection-moulded part / machine cycle per row, linked by MET_MachineCycleID
experimentalContext.qualityContext: All produced parts were manually inspected/classified; additional quality sources include scale, computer vision and infrared camera.

schemaInspection.commandsAndSetpoints: SET_* fields and DXP/DOS/DRY fields carrying Set/sv semantics are commands or set values and are not treated as direct measured waveform values.
schemaInspection.derivedAndNonMeasured: SIM_* fields are simulation outputs and CALC_* fields are calculated features. QUA area/max aggregates and Mean-suffixed peripheral fields are derived summaries. These are retained for learning/quality linkage but are excluded from measured-sample counting.
schemaInspection.labels: LBL_* fields are manual visual defect labels, including NOK, sink marks, sprue-circle, underfill and streak levels.
schemaInspection.unitsAndSemanticsReview: Source naming convention and data dictionary were reviewed by data-source family. Units are explicit for many cycle/scalar parameters in the source dictionary; vendor DataXplorer shorthand is retained without invented unit conversion. Generic vendor parameter/state fields remain bounded by their source semantics.

measurementBoundary.reasonSamplesNotYetAdded: The Parquet clearly contains real physical time-series arrays, but MouldMaster does not add them to the scalar-sample ledger until per-channel time bases, array lengths across every cycle, units and direct-measurement masks are normalized. This avoids counting setpoints, trigger/state arrays, simulation outputs or calculated summaries as physical samples.
